result.reason: The operative language adopts New York law and exclusive jurisdiction and venue in the state and federal courts located in New York County, exactly reaching the preferred position. Replacing mandatory arbitration and deleting arbitration-specific enforcement language are necessary to implement exclusive court jurisdiction, while the broad scope of covered disputes and the severability provision remain intact. The drafting is professional, though jurisdiction is stated somewhat repetitively and the clause retains the original excerpt’s awkward opening at subsection (b).
